description: This file contains JavaScript code that defines API functions for fetching user analytics data, such as tenant user summaries and active user trends, from backend endpoints. It includes helper functions for query parameter normalization and handles API responses and errors.

methods.name: normalizeQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Helper function to normalize query parameters by converting Date objects to ISO strings, handling strings, and filtering out undefined/null/empty string values.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a summary of tenant users with optional filters; calls GET /api/users/tenant-summary, processes response, and handles errors.

methods.name: getActiveUsersTrend(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches active user trend data with optional filters; calls GET /api/users/active-trend, processes response, and handles errors.
